name: MUMmer4 (nucmer / mummer)
scope_note: Scored mummer4 sparseSA (48-bit SA+ISA+LCP, essaMEM lineage). Notes: sparseMEM/essaMEM (sparse SA), E-MEM (hash-based, 5-6x on 12 cores, ~2 GB for human vs mouse) not scored.

name: libsais + libdivsufsort
scope_note: Construction libraries only (SA/GSA/BWT/LCP/PLCP), no query layer. Scored as best of pair: libsais primary; libdivsufsort ~3-4x slower and unreleased since 2010.

name: Go standard library index/suffixarray
scope_note: In-memory SA (SA-IS) with Lookup/FindAllIndex/Read/Write; SA unexported. No head-to-head benchmark found; DNA throughput unmeasured.

name: rust-bio + fm-index crate
scope_note: Scored as union (best of two crates per capability). rust-bio SA/BWT/FM/FMD; fm-index wavelet-matrix + RL FM. 2 GB human SA: bio 957 s/23.9 GB vs libsais 77 s. Changelog dates 4.2.2 as 2026-10-09.
